_provenance.derived_from: 60 Cambridge published AS mark schemes for 9618 (Papers 11-13, 21-23), June 2021 to November 2025
_provenance.derivation_policy: structure only. No mark-scheme wording is reproduced in learner-facing output.
_provenance.validation: 58 of 60 papers’ part tariffs sum to 75 exactly; the other two are within 2 marks (a part the parser could not read).

9618.subject: Cambridge International AS Level Computer Science

paper_architecture.P1: 75 marks, 90 minutes, sections 1-8: structured questions of 1-8 marks, most parts 1-4 marks, often set in a scenario that runs through the whole question.
paper_architecture.P2: 75 marks, 120 minutes, sections 9-12: structured questions around a scenario and its modules; answers in pseudocode with the insert of functions; algorithm-writing parts of 5-8 marks.
